note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super, one top text and the end card, so 3 graphics and the end card.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “Young people want a purpose.” Already on screen at 0:00. It does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:02.5. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:03 for 2 s, lower left above the captions: “Dr. J.D. LaRock”
mg.use: Put it on at 00:03 for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line CEO, Network for Teaching Entrepreneurship (NFTE) under it.

mg.title: Top text
mg.cue: Top text when he says “learning by doing” (about 00:21), 2 s: “Learning by doing”.
mg.use: Put it on when he says learning by doing (about 00:21) and hold 2 s. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: NFTE logo, white on NFTE purple, Fuel a Future Like Mine, NFTE.com/fuelafuture.
mg.src: NFTE's white logo from the NFTE brand kit (state/nfte/brand/logos, 9 Oct 2026), endcards/index.json.
mg.use: Put it right after the last line at 00:24.5 and hold it to the very last frame. No fade to black.
